page.overview:
Who is Dorian Boccolacci?

Dorian Maurice Gines Daniel Joan Boccolacci (born 9 September 1998 in Cannes) is a French racing driver who currently competes in the GT World Challenge Europe Endurance Cup for Boutsen Ginion Racing and in the GT World Challenge Asia for Phantom Global Racing.

A single-seater graduate, having won races in GP3 and raced in FIA Formula 2, Boccolacci later joined sports car racing, becoming the 2023 Porsche Carrera Cup France champion.
